note: Registered 64-hex digests for scripts/host_assumption_guard.py. A frozen digest must be HOST-INDEPENDENT to belong here: a fixture body's content hash, a synthetic placeholder, or a value whose producer excludes absolute paths. A digest computed over a payload that embeds host paths (e.g. cli._policy_export_payload, whose policy_hash changes with each root's absolute path_ref - findings F-B01-9) must NOT be registered: assert a platform-independent property instead.

cf0ac2adf9714fe003eb1d1497d678877840e35a.rationale: The SHIPPED resolver-side policy export (policy.export_policy). Its payload is path-redacted by design, so the hash is identical on every host and in CI; freezing it is the point of the case. Contrast with the consumer payload (cli._policy_export_payload -> policy_2x), whose policy_hash embeds each root's absolute path_ref and is therefore NOT registered - the B01 case asserts structure and cross-export agreement for it instead.
